response.explanation: Counts October 2026 orders with more than one attempt and divides by total October orders to get the retry fraction.
response.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN attempt_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retried_orders, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN attempt_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS retried_fraction FROM v_orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
